title: Auto-GPT for Online Decision Making: Benchmarks and Additional Opinions
reasoning: The paper focuses on benchmarking the performance of Auto-GPT styled agents and LLMs in online decision-making tasks, and introduces a method to incorporate additional opinions. While it mentions 'inherent biases' of GPT4, this refers to cognitive biases in task performance, not an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics in a human-centric sense.
